senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; דבל, cmp. דבב)a thick viscid mass, cake of pressed figs; fig used for pressing.
units: Pes. 87ᵇ (play on Diblayim, Hos. I, 3) she was sweet in the mouth of all כד׳ like figs; הכל … כד׳ all trod upon her as figs are trodden upon.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>הכניס עמו ד׳</he> he took the provision with him in a pressed state; <he>רוב מִכְנָסוֹ ד׳</he> most of his storage was &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 76a:15">Yoma 76ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keritot 1:20">Tosef. Ker. I, 20</cite>, a. e. <he>ד׳ קעילית</he> preserved figs from Keilah (which are intoxicating).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:2">Y. Bicc. III, beg. 65ᶜ</cite> <he>ד׳</he>, opp. <cite ref="C01291"><he>גרוגרות</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דְּבֵילוֹת</he>.
